scale: Capability priors use a coarse curator scale: 5=primary fit supported by official positioning plus empirical signal, 4=strong general fit, 3=usable generalist, 2=surface-limited, 1=poor fit, 0=unsupported. They are routing hints, not benchmark scores.
method: Blend evidence-backed capability priors with configured billing mode, fresh quota state, local dispatch reliability and verified local outcomes. Never treat vendor claims or model popularity as proof of task completion.

openai_official.claim: GPT-5.6 offers Sol for frontier capability, Terra for balance, Luna for high-volume efficiency, and explicit reasoning effort controls.

openai_codex_official.claim: Codex-family models are optimized for agentic coding.

anthropic_official.claim: Claude model tiers cover long-running agents, complex agentic coding, balanced speed/intelligence, reasoning, long context and multilingual work.

google_official.claim: Gemini 3.7 Flash is a workhorse for coding and agents and is the default model for the Antigravity agent.

google_long_context_official.claim: Gemini supports long-context and native multimodal input; long context still has retrieval, latency and cost tradeoffs.

grok_official.claim: Grok 4.6 targets code and agentic tool use; current events require Web Search or X Search.

nvidia_official.claim: NVIDIA hosts Llama 3.3 70B Instruct through NIM.

minimax_official.claim: MiniMax M2.7 targets agent harnesses, software engineering and office-document work.

terminal_bench.claim: Reproducible terminal tasks show that both model and agent harness materially affect coding-agent outcomes.

arena_agent.claim: Agent Arena aggregates user-observed outcomes and preferences; it is a directional signal, not a task-specific proof.

local_ledger.claim: Actual dispatch success, error class and latency on this machine.

local_outcomes.claim: Human or deterministic task verdicts recorded after replayable checks.

multimodal.label: 圖片影音與 PDF 理解

codex.prior_basis: Official agentic-coding specialization and tier guidance; Terminal-Bench is used only as a harness-sensitive directional check.

claude.prior_basis: Official complex agentic coding, long-context and reasoning positioning; independent agent benchmarks support use as a critic without fixing an exact rank.

grok.prior_basis: Official coding/tool-use positioning and explicit search requirement for current events; Arena is a broad user-outcome signal.

agy.prior_basis: Gemini capability priors are reduced where the local headless AGY surface cannot reliably exercise tools or multimodal inputs; local ledger governs availability.

gemini.prior_basis: Official long-context and multimodal positioning; actual CLI authentication, model access and local outcomes still govern availability.

nim.prior_basis: The configured Llama 3.3 70B text endpoint is treated as a bulk generalist; no frontier-agent capability is inferred from NIM hosting alone.

minimax.prior_basis: Official M2.7 agent/software/office positioning, discounted because current independent signals are broad and this configured surface is metered text API.

general.prior_basis: Conservative fallback for a configured provider without a curated family profile; local reliability and verified outcomes should dominate after enough evidence exists.
